values.note: Marinette County's own booking site takes reservations 184 days ahead. Check-in 3 pm, check-out noon.
A 2.5% card fee ($2 minimum) applies; the 2027 county fee schedule keeps $20 a night.
The water tower and dump flushing close after Oct 15 (earlier in a hard freeze); a hand pump stays on.

note: Marinette County Forest campground in pine and hardwood woods above the Peshtigo River, with walking trails to Strong Falls and trout fishing. An ATV/UTV spur links the park to the county trail system, with ATV parking at the campground. --Claude
summary: County park page, 2027 county fee schedule, campground map and 8 site photos read; Google rating taken. 15 non-electric sites, $20 + $10 reservation fee, vault toilets/water tower/dump, May 1-Nov 30 confirmed and now sourced; booking on the county's own site. Not waterfront kept. PIN move 1.1 km proposed (stored point is a road end on the river east of the park). ATV spur flagged (general campground, stays).
flags: PIN (>250 m): stored 45.5189,-88.3304 -> 45.5215,-88.3444 (Google's 'Goodman Park Campground' point). The stored point is the end of a different road on the river about 1.1 km EAST of the park; the county map puts the single loop (sites 1-15) north of the river and northwest of the lodges, off Benson Lake Rd, and Google's point falls there at a clearing in the woods. The loop itself is under canopy on Esri, so the exact centre is approximate.

OHV (flag only): the county advertises 'an ATV/UTV trail access spur that connects the trail system with the park' and the map shows 'ATV Parking (Campground Only)' at the loop entrance. A general county campground with ATV access, not a staging camp - stays per the rule.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront KEPT. The map draws sites 9-12 about 50-60 m from the river by its scale bar, with a dog-walking trail and woods between; site photos 9 and 11 show only forest; canopy hides everything on imagery. No view or open ground is shown.
